item.title: Generative Guidelines for This Hugo Blog Theme
item.description:
Core Structural Rules

  1. Categories, tags, and posts MUST be visualized using a Voronoi Treemap.

    • Categories form the top-level Voronoi partition
    • Tags are nested Voronoi partitions within category cells
    • Posts are leaf nodes within tag cells

  2. The Voronoi Treemap MUST represent hierarchy through spatial containment.
    Category → Tag → Post relationships MUST be encoded through nesting, not solely through color or labeling.

  3. The visual language of the theme MUST be inspired by Ghost in the Shell.
